subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should native `openclaw backup create` add pattern-level excludes from this PR, and what permanent contract should govern `.backupignore`, smart defaults, protected paths, and external asset filtering?
rationale: The code gap is real, but the behavior controls restore-critical and sensitive backup contents, adds new CLI/file surfaces, and overlaps with current backup reliability work.

options.title: Rebase And Narrow Native Excludes
options.body: Use this PR or a replacement after resolving the P1/P2 findings, conflicts, proof gap, and current-main backup hardening integration.

options.title: Define Contract First
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while maintainers specify default, ignore-file, protected-path, and external-asset semantics before accepting code.

options.title: Defer Core Excludes
options.body: Reject the native feature for now and steer users to plugin or ClawHub backup workflows only if maintainers explicitly decide core should stay coarse-grained.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Narrow Native Excludes
recommendation.body: Use this PR or a replacement after resolving the P1/P2 findings, conflicts, proof gap, and current-main backup hardening integration.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product and restore-safety decision, and recent backup cleanup plus prior routing make this the best available owner signal.
